scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it mithi_postgres psql -U mithi -d mithi_river
scripts.db:tables: docker exec mithi_postgres psql -U mithi -d mithi_river -c "\dt+" -c "SELECT id, component_type, data_date, kml_type, source, fetched_at, pg_column_size(payload) AS payload_bytes FROM component_history ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT 50;"
scripts.db:peek: docker exec mithi_postgres psql -U mithi -d mithi_river -c "SELECT id, component_type, data_date, kml_type, left(payload::text, 200) AS payload_preview FROM component_history ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10;"
scripts.dev:all: npm run db:up && npm run history:install && npm run dev:server
scripts.fetch:mithi-osm: node scripts/fetch_mithi_osm_corridor.mjs && node scripts/filter_mithi_river_bridges.mjs && node scripts/densify_mithi_mangroves.mjs
